title: Kafka east cluster-status: KRaft quorum
description: Reports the kafka-east KRaft controller quorum (leader + 3 voters) via kafka-metadata-quorum over each broker own mTLS keystore.

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-kafka smoke-0.H.2 + smoke-0.H.5 ALL GREEN; role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer applied

observe.what: 3 brokers, one controller-leader, all alive -- the live quorum view

whatProves: status reports the genuine KRaft controller quorum over mTLS (no managed driver).
